title: Campo Vivo ActBeCalf Official Zenodo Release v1
subtitle: Private CC BY copy for frozen external activity transfer
description: Official AcTBeCalf.csv from Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13259482, version 1.0. Thirty pre-weaned dairy calves, 25 Hz triaxial neck-collar data, 2,467,162 rows. Source paper: Dissanayake et al. (2025), Data in Brief 60, 111462, DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2025.111462. The Zenodo API declares CC BY 4.0. This private copy exists only to attach the official source data to a Kaggle GPU kernel; no modifications to the raw measurements. The evaluation is an external activity-classification challenge from a single farm, not a decision-policy or daily-prevalence dataset.
